Two tools rebuild a merged `OS9Boot` file after editing which modules it contains: **`COBBLER`** copies the in-memory (already-patched) boot image to disk, preserving any live patches; **`OS9GEN`** instead builds fresh from a module list read from disk, so it does *not* pick up in-memory changes. `MODBUSTER` (public-domain, D.P. Johnson) does the reverse of merging - it splits a merged `OS9Boot` back into individual module files.
